rows.text: Tell me your story...
Haha, my tales of thievery are even longer than Mnestia's golden thread... I've stolen more things than Aquila has eyes.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: What do you wish to hear? The most harrowing heist, or my proudest feat?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: The most harrowing heist.
There was no more thrilling escapade than the time Thanatos sent me a raven with a message.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: "Bartholos, O Bartholos," it said, "you can steal everything beneath the sky, except for one thing: Georios' secret fruit, buried within the earth. How would you even be able to taste it?"
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: So I turned into a Steelclaw Beast and dug into the earth for countless days, my journey ending with the fruit in my belly. Honestly, it didn't taste like much.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: So Thanatos said again: "Bartholos, O Bartholos, you can steal everything beneath the sky, except for one thing: Cerces' secret fruit, perched atop the Grove. How would you even be able to taste it?"
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: So I turned into a bird and flew, resting my feet on ten branches, my journey ending at the treetop. Honestly, it didn't taste like much.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Hearing this, Thanatos laughed aloud: "Bartholos, O Bartholos, you have been fooled! I have summoned the currents from craggy crevices, and the clouds of roiling dark to drop these two fruits bearing the 'Core of Death'."
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: "Now, the seeds of death grow within you. Your pranks will upend the lands, and your tricks will wither all life. And all this will be in my service."
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: That's so scary!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I had no choice but to reply to it: "That is harrowing, but who would eat the seeds along with the fruit?"
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Your proudest feat.
Crrkrrkk... material wealth is a most trite goal. There are many things to steal... Memories, wisdom, even status.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Neither keys nor crowbars are needed to steal them. Sometimes all it takes is a glib word, a heartfelt gesture, to have them swoon for your earnestness.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I used just this method to steal an unimaginable secret... Which is also the reason why I'm standing here before you.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Whether you take it as truth or just a harmless tall tale, that's up to you.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Gosh, you wouldn't be one of those types, would you? Obsessively digging into one's past, picking out its shattered fragments, and then presumptuously asserting that the other party has been healing their trauma for their whole life?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: If you're thinking of pretending to empathize with me, then pretentiously persuading me to turn over a new leaf, you can save it.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I have seen you in the past...
It's very different from your present self.
Crrkk, whose leg are you pulling? Me? Obsequious and earnestly polite? Curious and full of energy? Only unleashing harsh words in a fit of powerless rage after being bullied?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: Do you see any resemblance between me and these phrases?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: S—Someone must be impersonating me! Or perhaps, it could be one of the steps in my plan back then... That must be it!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: You sound agitated...
We're just chatting, don't get antsy.
Am I? Nonsense. I am more than happy to acquiesce if you wish to speak on other things. But if you keep persisting on this matter, don't blame me for what happens next!
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: What else did Zagreus say?

Ancestor Zagreus left many pearls of wisdom. Alas, people nowadays are selectively blind, only heeding Cerces' words — they can't even fathom that the paltry tricks of Cerces are all that remains after Zagreus stole everything else.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: What do you wish to hear?
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos

rows.text: I shan't see you off then. I should be on my walk on this idle afternoon.
rows.speaker: "Spirithief" Bartholos
